missing_value_meaning: Unknown or unavailable in retrieved content; never a negative factual claim

faculty_profiles.profile_id: Stable ID from name and canonical official source URL; not an authoritative person ID
faculty_profiles.name: Name as shown in official directory/profile
faculty_profiles.listed_by_units: Discovery context, not a list of all appointments
faculty_profiles.position_titles: Explicit extracted titles; may include historical or concurrent titles
faculty_profiles.research_topics: Brief factual topic phrases; empty array if not extracted
faculty_profiles.research_evidence_excerpt: Short quotation for traceability; not a full biography
faculty_profiles.fetched_at: Retrieval time in UTC, not a page publication or update date
faculty_profiles.retrieval_method: direct_official_page or search-service extracted text representation
faculty_profiles.source_crawl_hint: Source freshness hint from retrieval service when supplied; may be absent

collection_gaps.not_fetched_within_time_budget: Not attempted before stopping; not evidence of an inaccessible page
collection_gaps.retrieval_failed: Attempted but no usable page text obtained
collection_gaps.profile_identity_or_content_not_verified: Retrieved candidate did not satisfy profile identity/content rules
collection_gaps.research_topics_not_found_in_retrieved_c: Profile exists, research information missing from retrieved representation
